confirmed: Rail position after Integrations and before Advanced (settings.tsx; SET-014).
MCP, both groups' OAuth Clients and API keys switches and dynamic registration default off (migrations 0163 and 0171).
Copy address copies the /mcp Server address built from BASE_URL (mcp-settings/routes.ts serverAddress; settings-mcp.tsx).
Legal Users covers Administrators and Legal Team Members; Business Users row is separate (settings.mcp.legalHelp; api-keys/routes.ts readPolicy).
Guide Tools are always in the grant (mcp/auth.ts toolsets ['guide', ...]; register.ts toolRefusal).
API key lifetime 1 to 365, default 90, saves on blur or Enter, applies at approval (settings-mcp.tsx saveLifetime; api-keys/routes.ts approve lifetimeDays).
Each change saves at once, shows Settings saved., and writes org_settings.updated at admin_only (mcp-settings/routes.ts; settings-mcp.tsx).
Switch-off, ceiling removal and Read-only apply to the next request for keys and grants (mcp/auth.ts readCredentialContext; auth/oauth-grants.ts liveOAuthGrantFor; oauthContext).
Reachability: three named checks, 30-second cache, advisory while the authorization server runs; IPv6-only host fails IPv4 record (reachability.ts).
Plain-HTTP LAN: authorization server absent, PATCH returns mcp-oauth-unavailable with checks, six well-known aliases return 404 (oauth.ts; discovery.ts; e2e 63 pill assertion).

Four seeded Allowed Clients, three published identities with metadata URL captions, not editable, Copilot template with Teams and vscode.dev callbacks plus an empty slot (0171 seed; allowed-clients.ts PATCH refusals).
Your Client secret is ready dialog, Copy, Done, not shown again, rotation invalidates the old secret and keeps grants (allowed-clients.tsx; TECH-035 #1134 addendum; allowed-clients.test.ts).
Delete Client only for non-seeded registered entries (allowed-clients.tsx; allowed-clients.ts DELETE).
Your approvals in the bell with Deny and Approve, Mark all read leaves approvals, handled request leaves the group (notification-bell.tsx; api-keys/routes.ts handleApprovalItems).
API key requests card with Approve and Deny and Note (Optional); Active keys and grants collapsed with counts and the eight named columns (api-keys.tsx).
Administrator's own request self-approves and returns the key once (api-keys/routes.ts POST).
Tool calls in the last day links to /settings/audit-log/tool-calls?range=last-day (settings-mcp.tsx).
Rate-limit refusal names the limit and reset time (mcp/calls.ts).

OAuth grant lifetime (days) 1 to 365, default 90, bound at boot, existing grants keep expiry through refresh (app.ts oauthGrantRoutes(grantLifetimeDays); oauth-grants.ts after-hook; TECH-035 #1138 addendum).
Writes carry via attribution in History (e2e 63 'via ${clientName}').
limitations: Source inspection only. V-M40-MCP and V-M41-MCP still need the independent browser walkthrough.

The negative check 'an expired key cannot connect' cannot be produced in a walkthrough from the UI: the shortest API key lifetime is 1 day and the shortest grant lifetime is 1 day. The code refuses expired keys and grants with 401 (mcp/auth.ts, auth/oauth-grants.ts). The walkthrough needs a clock change or a database edit on the disposable lab, or must record the check as source-only.

V-M41-MCP 'new grants use the lifetime after restart' needs a real OAuth consent. The walkthrough can observe the new grant's Expires date in Active keys and grants after restarting the API and worker.

The guide says rotation keeps grants and invalidates the old secret. The Rotate secret path calls better-auth rotateClientSecret; allowed-clients.test.ts covers the new secret, and TECH-035 records that rotation keeps consent rows. I did not read the better-auth package source.

When Add Client or Generate secret fail on a plain-HTTP LAN address, the UI shows the generic 'The Client could not be saved. Check the callback URLs and try again.' or 'The Client secret could not be generated. Try again.' The API detail 'Configure HTTPS before ...' is not shown. The guide states the failure without quoting the message.
The walkthrough needs an HTTPS or loopback BASE_URL for the OAuth steps and a plain-HTTP LAN BASE_URL for the refusal check, so V-M41-MCP needs two lab network profiles.

The Claude Code, Claude Cowork and Claude Desktop steps describe vendor software. I could not check them against OpenLaw source. Claude Code's MCP page documents ${VAR} expansion for MCP configuration files but does not say whether a header added with claude mcp add --header expands at connect time. The walkthrough must confirm that openlaw connects with the single-quoted header.
The mcp-remote@0.14.3 bridge arguments (--header, --transport http-only, --header-file) are vendor behavior and are unverified here.
The negative check 'an expired key cannot connect' needs a clock change or database edit on the lab, because the shortest key lifetime is 1 day. Revocation can be walked through.
The guide does not quote the Client-side error text for Unauthorized, because each Client words the 401 differently. OpenLaw returns 401 'Authentication required.' with a WWW-Authenticate challenge.
